sources.title: [Bug]: LFM2.5-2.6B NPU inference fails after successful ... - GitHub
sources.snippet: The sibling model LFM2-2.6B (same export recipe, same machine) works end-to-end on NPU. LFM2.5-2.6B works on GPU with the same OpenVINO GenAI pipeline. This appears to be an NPU plugin / stateful inference issue specific to LFM2.5's graph (128K vocab, larger embeddings), not a quantization or export recipe problem.

sources.title: lfm25-openvino-intel-gpu-guide/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: LFM2.5 on an Intel discrete GPU with OpenVINO This repository-sized guide shows how to convert the public LiquidAI/LFM2.5-2.6B checkpoint to a stateful, weight-only INT8 OpenVINO model, run it on an Intel GPU, verify tokenizer and backend correctness, and benchmark it without mixing model quality with runtime speed.

sources.snippet: To convert an LFM2 model to an NPU-friendly INT4 quantized form, pass the additional --backup-precision int8_sym parameter to optimum-intel to ensure symmetric quantization of the linear part of the attention mechanism.
